name: Marriage Vows
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divine institution designed for companionship and unity, as God created a suitable helper for man and ordained that a man shall leave his parents and unite with his wife to become one flesh. Marriage vows are sacred commitments before God, who commands faithfulness and warns against treachery and divorce. Believers are called to honor their vows promptly and live joyfully with their spouse, recognizing marriage as a solemn covenant that reflects God's design and displeasure toward unfaithfulness.
